Zhihui Chen 陈致晖

Ph.D. Student in Artificial Intelligence, National University of Singapore 新加坡国立大学人工智能博士生

I am a PhD student in Artificial Intelligence at the National University of Singapore, advised by Prof. Mengling Feng.

My research centers on recursive self-improvement (RSI): letting the model set its own tasks, solve them, and grade itself, so that verified experience becomes training data for the next model — each version helps build its successor. The loop runs on coding agents first, where sandboxed execution provides a verifiable signal, and is now extending to medical agents (Med-Banana). A second line of my work detects AI-generated medical images and text (MedForge, DivScore).

I am currently a research intern on the foundation-model post-training team at Zhipu AI (Z.ai), working on coding-agent RSI post-training for the next-generation GLM foundation model. Previously I interned at ByteDance (VLM post-training; Farsight) and StepFun (StepAudio2.5 pre-training). I have received a research internship offer from the Qwen team at Alibaba Tongyi Lab, and was selected for Tencent’s Qingyun Program.

新加坡国立大学人工智能博士生，导师为 冯梦凌教授。

研究围绕 RSI（递归自进化）展开：让模型自己出题、自己求解、自己批改，通过验证的经验直接成为下一版模型的训练数据——每一版模型都参与打造下一版。这条循环先在 Coding Agent 上跑通，沙箱执行给出可检验的成功信号；同样的方法正推进到医疗 Agent（Med-Banana）。另一条线研究如何识别 AI 生成的医学影像与文本（MedForge、DivScore）。

现于智谱（Z.ai）基础模型后训练团队实习，参与 GLM 下一代基础模型的 Coding Agent RSI 后训练。此前在字节跳动（VLM 后训练，Farsight）和阶跃星辰（StepAudio2.5 基础模型预训练）实习。已获阿里通义实验室 Qwen 团队基础模型研究实习录用，并入选腾讯「青云计划」。

Research 研究方向 #

Direction 01 · Coding Agent + RSI 方向一 · Coding Agent + RSI

Coding agents that generate their own training data 让模型自己制造训练数据

Let the model set its own exam, sit it, and grade it: the agent proposes coding tasks and solves them in a sandbox, and verified experience becomes training data for the next model — capability compounds around this loop. Because execution is the grader, every step of self-improvement is checked against real results, making this the most direct and most measurable path toward models that improve themselves. 让模型自己出题、自己求解、自己批改：Coding Agent 生成编码任务并在沙箱中执行，通过验证的经验直接变成下一版模型的训练数据，能力沿这个循环逐轮累积。执行就是判卷——每一步自我改进都被真实结果检验，这是通往自我改进智能最直接、最可度量的路径。

Direction 02 · Medical Agents & Medical AI Safety 方向二 · 医疗 Agent 与医疗 AI 安全

Self-improving medical agents and medical content safety 自我改进的医疗 Agent 与医疗内容安全

Medicine is the hardest and most worthwhile arena for RSI: feedback depends on clinicians, and errors carry real cost. Med-Banana lets a medical image editing agent improve itself against verifier feedback — successful and failed trajectories alike are recycled into training data, so editing capability compounds round by round. Safety completes the line: as models learn to generate realistic medical images and text, MedForge and DivScore are built to catch them. 医疗是 RSI 最难也最值得推进的考场：反馈依赖医生，错误的代价极高。Med-Banana 让医学图像编辑 Agent 在验证器反馈中自我改进，成功与失败的轨迹都被回收为训练数据，编辑能力逐轮提升。安全侧与这条主线互补：当模型能生成逼真的医学影像与文本，MedForge 与 DivScore 负责把它们识别出来。
